formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))}; have x2 : Bool → List Bool → Prop := fun (x2 : Bool) (x3 : List Bool) => if x2 = Bool.true then ∃ (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x4 - x5 ∈ x1 ∧ x3 = (List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x6 = x4)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x6 = x5) else ∃ (x4 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x4.card = (4 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x6 ∈ x4 | x6 - x5 ∈ x1}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ)) ∧ x3 = (List.ofFn fun (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x5 ∈ x4)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (∀ x6 ∈ x4, x6 - x5 ∉ x1); have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x3 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (26 : ℕ) x3 ∧ ∀ (x4 : Bool) (x5 : List Bool), x2 x4 x5 → x3.eval x5 = x4; have x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∃ (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), x3 x5 ∧ x5.size < x4.size; have x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>   ∀ x6 < x5.gates.length,     have x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x5 x6;     have x9 : Bool := !x8.op.eval [];     ∀ x10 ∈ x8.inputs, ∃ (x12 : List Bool), x2 x9 x12 ∧ (x5.wires x12).getD x10 Bool.false = !x9 ∧ (x5.wires x12).getD ((26 : ℕ) + x6) Bool.false = x9; ∀ (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), x3 x6 → x4 x6 ∨ x5 x6)
plain_statement: It is false that: Plane of order 3, inputs as in the parent: every fan-in-at-most-two AND/OR circuit reading only earlier wires, true on every incident input and false on every quadrangle input, either has a strictly smaller such circuit, or each input of each OR gate is false on some incident input where the gate is true and each input of each AND gate is true on some quadrangle input where the gate is false.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Part 1 of 2 of a proof of: Plane of order 3: every AND/OR list of fan-in at most two accepting every incident point-line input
